state.subject_kind: a Swift test function from an iOS app built with The Composable Architecture, and the production code change it covers

fails-if-broken.instructions: Would this test fail if the behavior it names were broken?

tier.instructions: Which tier does this test belong in? T1: host unit test of logic (reducers, pure functions, clients with fakes). T2: simulator test of rendering or platform integration (snapshots, views). T3: end-to-end UI flow (XCUITest).

name-specificity.instructions: How specific is the regression the test's name says it catches? vague: names no symptom or restates the behavior; partial: names an area but not the symptom; specific: names a user- or caller-visible symptom.

asserts-implementation.instructions: Does the test assert implementation details (private call order, internal state, exact log text, which collaborator was called) rather than observable behavior?
